problem:
Given that the mean of the following data set is $10,$ find the value of $b:$ 

$$
b,\,1,\,b,\,1,\,b
$$
worked_solution:
If we have a data set that consists of the points ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n},$ then the mean is denoted by $\overset{―}{x}$ and is given by the following formula:

$$
\overset{―}{x}=\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i}
$$

Here, there are $n=5$ data points. Adding up all the points in the data set, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{5}{x}_{i} & =b+1+b+1+b \\  & =2+3b.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the mean is given by the expression

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{x} & =\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i} \\  & =\frac{1}{5}\cdot (2+3b) \\  & =\frac{2+3b}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, since we're told that $\overset{―}{x}=10,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}10 & =\frac{2+3b}{5} \\ 50 & =2+3b \\ 48 & =3b \\ b & =16.\end{aligned}
$$
